questions.prompt: The enemy, having seized the city, fled through the dark forest.
questions.answer: Hostēs urbe captā per silvam obscūram fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The general desired to take the camp before nightfall.
questions.answer: Dux castra ante noctem capere cupiēbat.

questions.prompt: The soldiers were digging a deep ditch while the enemy approached.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs fossam altam fodiēbant dum hostēs appropinquābant.

questions.prompt: When the boy had thrown the spear, the wild beast fled swiftly.
questions.answer: Cum puer hastam iēcisset, fera celeriter fūgit.

questions.prompt: The queen bore a son whom the whole state loved.
questions.answer: Rēgīna fīlium peperit quem tōta cīvitās amābat.

questions.prompt: We desire to make peace with the neighboring tribes.
questions.answer: Cum fīnitimīs gentibus pācem facere cupimus.

questions.prompt: The wave was shaking the small ship on the deep sea.
questions.answer: Unda parvam nāvem in altō marī quatiēbat.

questions.prompt: The wolf seizes the lamb and carries it off into the woods.
questions.answer: Lupus agnum rapit et in silvās portat.

questions.prompt: They will flee from the city when they behold the flames.
questions.answer: Ex urbe fugient cum flammās cōnspexerint.

questions.prompt: The philosopher goes slowly, thinking about death.
questions.answer: Philosophus lentē graditur dē morte cōgitāns.

questions.prompt: Let us take up arms and defend our fatherland.
questions.answer: Arma capiāmus et patriam nostram dēfendāmus.

questions.prompt: The radiant beauty of the maiden enticed the young men.
questions.answer: Candor virginis iuvenēs allēxit.

questions.prompt: Since they had endured great toils, the soldiers took the town.
questions.answer: Cum magnōs labōrēs passī essent, mīlitēs oppidum cēpērunt.

questions.prompt: The king desired to behold the temple built by his ancestors.
questions.answer: Rēx templum ā maiōribus aedificātum cōnspicere cupiēbat.

questions.prompt: The gods make the fields fruitful with rain.
questions.answer: Deī agrōs pluviā fēcundōs faciunt.

questions.prompt: While dying, the hero threw his sword into the river.
questions.answer: Moriēns hērōs gladium in flūmen iēcit.

questions.prompt: The farmer digs the earth in order to plant a tree.
questions.answer: Agricola terram fodit ut arborem serat.

questions.prompt: Fortune often snatches away what we most desire.
questions.answer: Fortūna saepe rapit id quod maximē cupimus.

questions.prompt: The citizens flee lest the tyrant capture them.
questions.answer: Cīvēs fugiunt nē tyrannus eōs capiat.

questions.prompt: The mother bore twins during the harsh winter.
questions.answer: Māter geminōs asperā hieme peperit.

questions.prompt: We shall build a bridge so that the army may cross the river.
questions.answer: Pontem faciēmus ut exercitus flūmen trānseat.

questions.prompt: The earthquake shakes the walls of the ancient temple.
questions.answer: Terrae mōtus mūrōs templī antīquī quatit.

questions.prompt: Advance, soldiers, and seize the standards of the enemy!
questions.answer: Gradiminī, mīlitēs, et hostium signa rapite!
